checks.title: Same IRI used for two unrelated concepts
checks.description: One IRI is typed with two classes where neither is a specialisation of the other, so two mappings are minting the same identifier for different things.
checks.remediation: Decide which concept owns the IRI template and change the other mapping's BIND, or add the discriminator that keeps the two apart.
checks.cucumber_scenario: No IRI denotes two unrelated concepts
